# Results

## Cases over time


<!-- TASK 4 — FIGURE + CAPTION
     Replace the TODO caption below. The chunk label already starts with
     `fig-`, which is what makes the figure cross-referenceable. -->


```{r}
#| label: fig-cases
#| fig-cap: "TODO: write a caption"

ggplot(cases, aes(month, n, colour = region)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Cases")
```

## Summary table


<!-- TASK 6 — TABLE + CAPTION
     1. Write a real caption instead of the TODO.
     2. A raw data frame prints as ugly monospaced text. Pipe the result into
        `kable()` to get a properly formatted table:

        cases |>
          group_by(region) |>
          summarise(total = sum(n), mean = round(mean(n), 1)) |>
          kable()                                                            -->


```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| tbl-cap: "TODO: write a caption"

cases |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarise(total = sum(n), mean = round(mean(n), 1))
```
